name: Sasquatch
summary: Large bipedal primate reported across North American forest regions. Prefers not to be photographed and is remarkably consistent about it.

children.text: Reported height 2.1 to 2.7 metres, heavy build, dark hair. Witnesses describe an unhurried gait and a strong odour. Footprint casts cluster between 38 and 46 centimetres.
The Bureau notes that the subject is reported in every region with dense forest and poor mobile coverage.

name: Mothman
summary: Winged humanoid with reflective red eyes, reported near industrial sites and bridges. Associated with a general feeling that something is about to happen.

children.text: Reported wingspan approaching three metres. Witnesses consistently mention the eyes, which reflect vehicle headlights. Sightings tend to precede or follow periods of local anxiety.
The Bureau records the association without drawing a conclusion from it.

name: Jersey Devil
summary: Hooved, winged creature of the Pine Barrens with a documented reputation that predates the state highway network.

children.text: Described variously as horse-headed, bat-winged and forked-tailed. Its scream is the most frequently reported feature and is often confused with the equally alarming sound of a fox.

name: Chupacabra
summary: Reported livestock predator. Physical descriptions vary between spined reptile and hairless canine, which the Bureau considers a data-quality problem.

children.text: Reports concentrate on rural livestock losses. Recovered specimens have so far been identified by veterinary staff as coyotes with advanced mange. The Bureau keeps the file open on procedural grounds.

name: Loch Ness Monster
summary: Large aquatic animal reported in a Scottish freshwater loch. Photographs are plentiful and, in the Bureau’s view, uniformly unhelpful.

children.text: Reported length 6 to 15 metres, humped back, long neck. Most sightings occur in calm conditions at a distance greater than 300 metres, which is when a log is most convincing.

name: Skunk Ape
summary: Swamp-dwelling primate reported in the American south-east. Identified chiefly by its smell, which witnesses describe with unusual precision.

children.text: Reported height 1.8 to 2.3 metres, reddish-brown hair. The odour is described as sulphurous and is reported to arrive before the subject does.

name: Silent Triangle
summary: Large dark triangular craft, three lights at the corners, no engine noise. Typically reported moving slowly at low altitude.

children.text: Reported span 30 to 200 metres. Witnesses stress the absence of sound and the way the craft blots out stars rather than reflecting light.
The Bureau notes that the shape is commonly explained by aircraft in formation, and commonly not accepted as an explanation by the person who saw it.

name: Tic-Tac Object
summary: Smooth white capsule-shaped object with no visible wings, rotors or exhaust. Reported to accelerate in ways aircraft do not.

children.text: Reported length 12 metres, uniformly white, no visible control surfaces. Reports come mostly from trained observers, which the Bureau finds both reassuring and unhelpful.

name: Classic Disc
summary: Saucer-shaped metallic object. The shape that started the filing system.

children.text: Reported diameter 10 to 40 metres. Metallic finish, occasional rim lights, often a wobble. In practice, most discs on file are weather balloons, lenticular clouds or lens flare, and the Bureau says so cheerfully.

name: Luminous Orb Cluster
summary: Group of glowing lights moving in formation. Frequently a satellite train. Occasionally not.

children.text: Reported as a line or cluster of 5 to 60 lights moving at constant speed on a straight path. Since the launch of satellite constellations the Bureau receives a wave of these after every deployment and tries to keep an open mind about the remainder.

name: Grey Humanoid
summary: Small grey-skinned humanoid with large dark eyes. The most frequently reported non-human figure in the Bureau’s files.

children.text: Reported height 1.0 to 1.4 metres, large head, large dark eyes, thin limbs. The description has been stable for decades, which the Bureau notes is either evidence or a very durable illustration.

name: Nordic Humanoid
summary: Tall, fair-haired humanoid described as calm and human-like. Reports are rare and unusually polite.

children.text: Reported height 1.9 to 2.2 metres, pale complexion, long hair. Witnesses often describe being reassured. The Bureau treats reassurance from an unidentified being as a data point, not a comfort.

name: Mantis-type Humanoid
summary: Tall, thin, insectoid figure with a triangular head. Reported at night, generally in the corner of a room or the edge of a headlight beam.

children.text: Reported height 1.8 to 2.4 metres, elongated limbs, triangular head, motionless posture. Witnesses report a sense of being observed rather than approached.

name: Grey Lady
summary: Translucent female figure in period dress, reported in old buildings, generally on staircases and generally at the end of a shift.

children.text: Reported in historic buildings worldwide. Usually silent, usually alone, usually gone before a phone can be located. Accounts are sympathetic in tone and the Bureau records them in the same spirit.

name: Shadow Figure
summary: Dark human-shaped silhouette seen at the edge of vision, typically at night, typically in a doorway.

children.text: Reported height 1.7 to 2.1 metres, no features, darker than the surrounding dark. It is reported to withdraw when looked at directly, which makes it difficult to file a description and easy to file a complaint.

name: Poltergeist
summary: Disturbance phenomenon: knocking, moving objects, doors. Frequently traced to plumbing, settlement or a very determined teenager.

children.text: Reports centre on a household and a period of weeks. Cases with an identified mundane cause are common. The Bureau keeps them on file as evidence of how much a house can do on its own.

name: Jinn (reported presence)
summary: Beings described in Islamic tradition. The Bureau takes no position on matters of faith and records only what witnesses report.

children.text: Jinn are described in the Quran and in Islamic tradition as beings created from smokeless fire. Many families hold this belief as a matter of faith and do not regard an account of a presence as a curiosity.

The Bureau records circumstances as reported, will not characterise any account as mistaken, and does not offer explanations of belief. Any observable factors noted on a file (noise, air movement, building conditions) are recorded for completeness and are never offered in place of a family’s understanding.

name: Wandering Spirit
summary: Reported presence without a fixed form: warmth, a sense of company, a change in the air. Usually described as gentle.

children.text: Reports are typically brief and typically calm. Witnesses describe warmth, a scent, or the sense of being accompanied. Many families and traditions understand these experiences in their own terms, and the Bureau records them in the witness’s own words.

name: Secret Society Activity
summary: Organised private gatherings of unclear purpose. All societies on file are invented. The paperwork, unfortunately, is very real.

children.text: Reports concern coordinated gatherings, unlisted premises, and membership records that are difficult to obtain. The Bureau’s files contain only fictional societies and the Bureau makes no claim about any real organisation.

name: Ritual Site Activity
summary: Circles, candles, symbols and other arrangements found at a site with no obvious explanation. Frequently explained. Occasionally not.

children.text: Reports describe arrangements of candles, salt, stones or markings. A large share resolve to gatherings, art projects or land-use permits. The Bureau records the arrangement, not any belief behind it.

title: Tall figure crossing Route 101 at dusk

sighting.description: Witness was driving north at approximately 45 mph when a bipedal figure crossed the road about 40 metres ahead. Estimated height 2.4 metres, covered in dark hair. The figure did not run. It walked. Witness stopped, engaged hazard lights and observed for roughly 12 seconds before the figure entered the treeline. Witness notes the figure "did not appear to be in a hurry". The dashcam was, regrettably, not recording.

evidence.caption: Footprint impression at the road shoulder, photographed the following morning

evidence.quote: It looked at me like I was the one who was out of place.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Credible daylight-adjacent sighting with a physical trace and a consistent account.
triage.memo: The witness account is specific, unhurried and free of embellishment. Height estimate is consistent with the width of the roadway. A footprint impression of 41 cm was recovered from the shoulder. No competing explanation fits the stride length described. Recommended for investigation.

title: Large figure at campsite, footprints "too small"

sighting.description: Witness heard heavy movement outside the tent at approximately 22:20 and shone a torch toward the noise. A large dark shape stood upright for around 40 seconds, then dropped to all fours and left. Witness measured footprints in the morning and found them smaller than expected, at 17 cm, and with visible claw marks.

evidence.quote: I was sure it was standing. Then it was not standing.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Behaviour and footprints are consistent with a black bear.
triage.memo: A 17 cm print with claw marks is a bear print. The upright posture followed by a drop to all fours is a known bear behaviour when investigating a smell of food. The witness did not report a food storage container. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Winged figure over the Silver Bridge site

location.placeName: Ohio River bank near the memorial

sighting.description: Witness, a night-shift delivery driver, stopped near the river to check a tyre. A large winged figure passed low overhead, silent, with two red points of light at head height that brightened as it passed a streetlamp. Wingspan estimated at over two metres. Witness reports an immediate feeling that "something was about to happen". Nothing happened. Witness has asked us to note that this is the worst part.

evidence.quote: No sound. Big as a door. Two red lights, like a car in the rain.
evidence.speaker: Witness

evidence.description: Witness heard a dry rustling, then nothing, before the figure appeared.

triage.summary: Detailed report with the classic reflective-eye feature at a location with a long file history.
triage.memo: Account is consistent with 14 earlier reports from the same stretch of river. The reflective eyes are a well-recorded feature and the witness could not have been expected to know it. The Bureau notes the possibility of a large owl or heron and has requested nothing further from the witness. Recommended for investigation.

title: Screaming creature in the cedar swamp

location.placeName: Cedar swamp trail, Wharton State Forest

sighting.description: Two hikers, camping off-trail, heard a sustained shriek from the swamp at approximately 22:30 and again 40 minutes later. One hiker briefly saw a dark shape crossing a clearing with an upright posture and what she described as "folded wings". No clear view was obtained. The second hiker did not see anything and would like that on the record.

evidence.description: Two shrieks, second one closer, lasting roughly 4 seconds each.

evidence.quote: I saw a shape, not a creature. I want to be accurate.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Audio account plausible but a fox or barred owl cannot be excluded; visual is brief.
triage.memo: A fox’s scream is the leading candidate and is frequently reported as alarming. The visual account is brief and made at 90 metres in darkness. The witness’s care about the limits of what she saw is noted and, in the Bureau’s view, is the most credible feature of the file. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Livestock predator behind the feed store

sighting.description: Farmer reports finding two chickens dead with small puncture marks and observed a hairless, grey-skinned animal with a spiny ridge along its back near the coop. The animal ran on four legs when approached. Farmer photographed it from a distance of 15 metres.

evidence.caption: The animal, moments before it left the property

triage.summary: Hairless four-legged animal with skin condition, consistent with a mangy coyote.
triage.memo: Hairless skin, grey pigmentation and a visible spine ridge are typical of advanced mange in canines. This description matches every recovered specimen on file. The chicken losses are consistent with any small predator. Routed for automatic closure.

title: Long-necked shape in calm water

sighting.description: Witness on the shore observed a dark, elongated shape moving against the direction of the surface ripple for about three minutes. The shape had a raised section that the witness estimated at 1.5 metres. No boat traffic was visible. A second observer, on the far bank, has not been located.

evidence.caption: The shape, 420 metres out, a small dark mark on flat water

evidence.quote: It was going the wrong way for a log.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Distant observation of a slow shape in calm water. Log, wake or otter cannot be ruled out.
triage.memo: Observation distance of 420 metres is at the limit where floating debris becomes convincing. The witness’s point about direction is fair: a log moves with the current, and the loch has several. The photograph does not settle it. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Foul smell and upright figure at the boardwalk

sighting.description: Witness smelled a strong sulphurous odour for several minutes before an upright, reddish-haired figure crossed the boardwalk ahead. The figure was estimated at 2 metres tall and moved into shallow water without apparent effort. Witness also filed CFO-2023-0003 in the Pacific North-west. The Bureau notes the coincidence and the witness’s remarkable itinerary.

evidence.quote: The smell arrived first. That is how I knew before I saw.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Detailed sensory account with a physical trace; prior file history for the witness is consistent.
triage.memo: A second party on the boardwalk independently reported the odour, which raises the file above a single-witness account. The footprint length is within the range of the subject file. The witness’s prior report (CFO-2023-0003) is treated as corroboration of credibility, not of the event. Recommended for investigation.

title: Winged creature seen at a gas station

sighting.description: Witness reports a large winged figure with horns standing next to the air pump. It waved. Witness has since been informed that Halloween falls on the same date. Witness maintains the figure was "very committed".

evidence.caption: The figure by the air pump

triage.summary: Costumed person at a rest stop on 31 October.
triage.memo: The figure waved, wore visible boots and stood next to an air pump on the one night of the year when this is the most probable explanation. The photograph shows a zip. The Bureau congratulates the costume. Routed for automatic closure.

title: Silent triangle over the Extraterrestrial Highway

sighting.description: Witness and a passenger, driving at night, observed a large dark triangular object moving slowly and silently above the highway at an estimated altitude of 300 metres. Three dim white lights at the corners. The object blocked out the stars as it passed. Vehicle radio, which was on, did not change. Duration of the observation was 95 seconds.

evidence.quote: It did not reflect anything. It just removed stars.
evidence.speaker: Witness

evidence.caption: Three lights at the corners, taken through the windscreen

triage.summary: Two independent observers, unusual duration, no aircraft signature.
triage.memo: Two observers agree on shape, lighting and the absence of sound over a period of 95 seconds. No scheduled aircraft was operating in the area at the time. The Bureau notes the proximity of restricted airspace and offers no comment. Recommended for investigation.

title: White capsule-shaped object near the perimeter

location.placeName: Public road, south of the boundary warning signs

sighting.description: Witness, a hiker, observed a smooth white capsule-shaped object approximately 12 metres long hovering at low altitude beyond the boundary signage. No wings, rotors or exhaust were visible. It accelerated horizontally in less than two seconds and was out of view. Two vehicles with tinted windows arrived shortly afterwards. Witness was asked to move along. Witness moved along.

evidence.quote: Whatever it was, it did not need a runway.
evidence.speaker: Witness

evidence.caption: White object over the ridge line

triage.summary: Distinct object description consistent with the subject file, at a restricted site.
triage.memo: The observed acceleration and shape match the subject file. The presence of a security response is noted. The witness followed instructions and is commended for it. Recommended for investigation. Please note this file is subject to the usual restrictions on where a file may be discussed.

title: Line of glowing lights crossing the red rocks

sighting.description: A group of witnesses on a viewpoint observed a line of approximately 30 evenly spaced white lights moving in single file across the sky from west to east at a steady pace. No sound. The lights faded out one by one at the eastern horizon.

triage.summary: Satellite train. Timing matches a launch deployment 3 days earlier.
triage.memo: A steady single-file procession of lights that fade at the same point in the sky is the signature of a satellite train leaving Earth’s shadow. A deployment matching the timing is on public record. The Bureau appreciates the witnesses’ report and the quality of the photograph. Routed for automatic closure.

title: Metallic disc hovering above the mesa

sighting.description: Witness observed a silver disc-shaped object hanging motionless above a mesa for approximately five minutes. It rocked slightly and reflected sunlight. It then descended out of view. Witness notes wind conditions were strong that day.

evidence.caption: Small silver disc over the mesa

triage.summary: A weather balloon released from the regional airport that afternoon.
triage.memo: A silver object that rocks in strong wind, holds position and then descends is a weather balloon, which the local airport released at 17:30. The Bureau notes that this is what the object was in 1947 as well, and that no one has ever been persuaded by it. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Triangular craft pacing a car on the desert road

location.placeName: Dirt road west of the boundary

sighting.description: Witness reports a triangular dark object that paced the vehicle for about three minutes at a lateral distance of 200 metres, matching the car’s speed of 30 mph. Lights at the corners. When the witness stopped, the object stopped. When the witness started, it started. Witness would like the Bureau to know this was not a comfortable drive.

evidence.quote: I stopped and it stopped. That is the part I keep coming back to.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Pacing behaviour is notable; a drone or aircraft cannot be ruled out. Second file from this witness.
triage.memo: The stop-and-start behaviour is the item of interest. A drone operating in the area would behave this way. The witness filed CFO-2025-0002 ten months earlier and is treated as reliable. The file is held for review pending a check of operator records. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Cluster of pulsing orbs above the ridge

sighting.description: Witness observed five amber orbs in a loose group above a ridge line, pulsing slowly in brightness. Two drifted out of the group and rejoined. They remained visible for seven minutes and then went out together. Witness is the same person as in CFO-2024-0005 and asks that this be considered "a different night".

evidence.caption: Five amber orbs over the ridge

triage.summary: Amber pulsing lights, drifting group. Flares or lanterns are possible; no source identified.
triage.memo: Amber colour and slow pulsing suggest flares or sky lanterns, though the group behaviour is unusual. The witness’s previous report (CFO-2024-0005) was credible. No scheduled flare activity was found in the area. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Capsule-shaped object above the test range

location.placeName: Public viewing area on the perimeter road

sighting.description: Witness observed a white capsule-shaped object at an estimated altitude of 3,000 metres. It moved north at high speed, stopped abruptly, then moved east at a right angle. No trail. Duration of the observation 22 seconds.

evidence.quote: It stopped like it had changed its mind.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Right-angle course change at speed, consistent with the subject file.
triage.memo: The right-angle turn at speed is the feature that distinguishes this account from ordinary aircraft. The witness is a repeat filer (see CFO-2026-0004 and CFO-2025-0007) whose accounts have been consistent. Recommended for investigation.

title: Small grey figure in the wash behind the range

location.placeName: Dry wash south of the perimeter road

sighting.description: Witness reports a small grey-skinned figure, approximately 1.2 metres tall, standing in a dry wash. Large dark eyes. It did not react to the vehicle headlights and remained motionless until the witness reversed. The witness is the same person as in CFO-2025-0004 and CFO-2025-0007 and has been asked whether they are aware of the pattern. They are.

evidence.quote: It was not afraid of me. That was the worst part.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Small motionless figure at night; a coyote, an owl on a post or a survey marker cannot be excluded.
triage.memo: A motionless figure at 35 metres in headlights is a familiar misidentification of a survey stake or a large bird. The witness’s track record on the Bureau’s files is otherwise good. The file is held for the Director. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Tall visitor offering reassurance

sighting.description: Witness reports meeting a tall, fair-haired man on a trail who spoke calmly about "the coming changes" and advised the witness to "be kind to your neighbours". The man was approximately 2 metres tall. He left without walking. Witness later found that the trail has a well-known guide who runs a wellness retreat and is 6 feet 6.

evidence.quote: He was very kind. It was slightly too much.
evidence.speaker: Witness

triage.summary: Tall local trail guide. The advice is sound and unrelated to any extraterrestrial matter.
triage.memo: A tall, calm man giving encouraging advice on a trail in Sedona is more probably a retreat guide than a visitor from elsewhere. The Bureau does not dispute the advice. The witness is asked to be kind to the guide. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Insectoid figure at the roadside, unmoving

sighting.description: Witness reports a tall, thin figure standing at the roadside in the headlights. Triangular head, long limbs, completely still. As the vehicle passed, the figure rotated its head to follow. The witness reports being unable to move the vehicle for a further 30 seconds. Passenger asleep throughout, and now unhelpful.

evidence.quote: It rotated its head to follow us. That is not a stick.
evidence.speaker: Witness

evidence.caption: Thin figure at the edge of the headlight beam

triage.summary: Specific movement detail at close range, matching the subject file.
triage.memo: The head rotation is the item of interest: it distinguishes this from a Joshua tree, which is the more common candidate in the area. The witness was alert and specific. The Bureau has requested no explanation for the passenger. Recommended for investigation.

title: Grey figure and a light in the sky, same hour

sighting.description: Witness reports a small grey figure approaching the fence line and a bright stationary light in the sky above it. Both departed within 70 seconds. Witness has filed CFO-2025-0004 and CFO-2026-0004 and states, with dignity, that they are not enjoying this.

evidence.quote: I go for the desert. This keeps happening.
evidence.speaker: Witness

evidence.caption: Stationary light above the fence line

triage.summary: Figure and aerial light in the same 70-second window, corroborated by a second observer.
triage.memo: A second observer independently recorded the light. The figure was seen by the witness alone. Together with two earlier files, this witness now has the most complete record on the Bureau’s books at this site. Recommended for investigation.

title: Woman in grey on the stair of the vaults

location.placeName: South Bridge vaults, guided tour route

sighting.description: Witness, a tour guide, observed a woman in grey period dress standing on the stair at the end of the group. She was seen by the witness and by two tourists. The figure did not appear to touch the steps and vanished when a torch was pointed at her. The two tourists have provided written statements and a small amount of tea.

evidence.quote: Two of us saw her. We are both quite sure.
evidence.speaker: Tourist

evidence.description: A soft footfall on stone, with no visible person.

triage.summary: Three independent observers, consistent description, well-documented location.
triage.memo: Three observers agree on dress, position and manner of departure. The location has a long file history and all earlier reports describe the same stair. The guide reported it without embellishment. Recommended for investigation.

title: Dark shape in a doorway of the guest room

sighting.description: Guest reports a man-shaped silhouette in the bedroom doorway at approximately 02:30. The shape was darker than the corridor behind it and left when the witness turned on a lamp. A search of the room and corridor found no one. The hotel has advised that the corridor contains a coat rack.

evidence.quote: It was there and then I put the lamp on and it was not there.
evidence.speaker: Guest

triage.summary: Common peripheral-vision report, but the witness was awake and looking directly at the doorway.
triage.memo: The silhouette was observed while the witness was looking directly at it, which distinguishes the file from the more usual peripheral report. The coat rack is noted and is not obviously the right shape. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Knocking in the walls of the rented house

location.placeName: Rented house on a quiet street

sighting.description: Tenants report repeated knocking from inside the walls, always between 02:00 and 03:30, for three consecutive weeks. A kitchen cupboard door opened twice. The household comprises two adults and a dog. The dog is calm. The tenants have asked whether the Bureau can help, and, if not, whether it can recommend a plumber.

evidence.description: Rhythmic knocking in the wall, three or four knocks at a time.

triage.summary: Knocking pattern consistent with pipes expanding as the heating cycles off.
triage.memo: Knocking at 02:00 to 03:30 in cold weather, in an older house, matches the timing of a boiler cycling down. The cupboard door has a worn catch. The dog’s lack of concern is, in the Bureau’s experience, the most reliable indicator on file. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Figure in a window, reflected

sighting.description: Witness reports a female figure in an upper window of an unoccupied tenement. The figure was still and pale. The witness photographed the window and later noted that it faces the street where a woman had been standing.

evidence.caption: The upper window, with a reflection of the street below

triage.summary: Reflection of a passer-by in an upper window.
triage.memo: The photograph shows a reflection of the street in the glass, including a woman on the pavement whose position matches the figure. The witness is a reliable source, as shown by CFO-2024-0006, and this is a reasonable mistake in poor light. Routed for automatic closure.

title: Tall dark figure on the landing, at the same time each night

sighting.description: Homeowner reports a tall dark figure standing on the upper landing at 01:10 on four consecutive nights. On the fourth night the homeowner set up a camera on the stairs. The camera recorded nothing and the homeowner recorded the camera. A neighbour confirms hearing the stairs creak on the same nights.

evidence.quote: Four nights. Same time. It does not seem to mind me.
evidence.speaker: Homeowner

evidence.description: A slow creak on the fourth stair, twice, at 01:10.

triage.summary: Repeatable timing, a corroborating neighbour, and a camera that recorded nothing.
triage.memo: The regular timing and the neighbour’s independent account raise the file well above a single-witness report. A camera that records nothing is, in the Bureau’s view, more interesting than one that records something. Recommended for investigation.

title: Knocking from the sealed storage room

sighting.description: A family of five reports repeated knocking from a sealed storage room in the evenings, and an occasional smell of smoke with no source. An elder relative states that the family believes a jinn is present in the apartment and asks that their belief be recorded as they hold it. The family has asked the Bureau not to explain it away. They are not asking for anything else.

evidence.quote: We are not afraid. We would like it written down as we say it.
evidence.speaker: Family elder

evidence.description: Knocking from the storage room, unhurried, three at a time.

triage.summary: Family account recorded as given. The Bureau takes no position on matters of faith.
triage.memo: The account is recorded in the family’s own words. The Bureau takes no position on matters of faith and offers no explanation of belief. For completeness only: the building is old, with shared ventilation and pipework, and the smell of smoke may correspond to a neighbouring kitchen. These observations are not offered in place of the family’s understanding. Routed to the Director for review.

title: Voices in the archive room, at night

sighting.description: A night-shift security guard reports hearing voices from an empty archive room over several nights. Nobody was inside. He describes a presence he understood in the terms of his own faith, recited protective verses, and reports that the sounds stopped. He asks that the account be recorded accurately and respectfully. It is.

evidence.quote: I did what my family taught me. It stopped. I want that written as it happened.
evidence.speaker: Security guard

evidence.description: Low voices from behind a closed door; the room was empty and locked.

triage.summary: Witness account recorded in his own terms. Room was empty and locked. The Bureau takes no position on matters of faith.
triage.memo: The account is specific, calm and consistent across several nights. The room was verified empty and locked. The Bureau records the witness’s understanding of the event as he gave it and does not characterise it as mistaken. Routed to the Director for review.

title: A warm, gentle presence in the guest room

location.placeName: Guest room of a family home

sighting.description: A guest reports a sense of warmth and quiet company in the room where a grandparent used to sleep, along with a faint scent of a familiar perfume. The guest describes the experience as comforting and asks for nothing except that it be recorded. The family is content with this.

evidence.quote: It felt like being kept company. I was not frightened.
evidence.speaker: Guest

triage.summary: Gentle account, recorded in the witness’s own words. The Bureau takes no position on matters of faith.
triage.memo: The account is short, calm and specific. The Bureau records it as given and offers no explanation of how the witness or the family understands it. Routed to the Director for review.

title: Silent gathering in a lodge that is on no register

location.placeName: Three-storey hall on a side street

sighting.description: Witness, a building surveyor, reports a lodge hall that appears on no property register. Through a ground-floor window, roughly forty people in grey coats held lanterns and stood in complete silence for 25 minutes. When questioned, a man at the door said "you have not seen this". The witness has since been unable to find the building. The hall is real. The Bureau has found only its name: the Order of the Hollow Lantern. The Order does not, to the Bureau’s knowledge, exist.

evidence.quote: Forty people. Grey coats. Not one of them spoke. I timed it.
evidence.speaker: Surveyor

evidence.caption: The hall entrance, side street, in the rain

triage.summary: Detailed observation of a coordinated silent gathering at an unregistered premises.
triage.memo: The witness is a professional surveyor and his account of the premises is precise. A gathering of forty people who do not speak for 25 minutes is unusual on any measure. The Order of the Hollow Lantern is a fictional society in the Bureau’s files, and the file is written accordingly. No claim is made about any real organisation. Recommended for investigation.

title: Circle of candles and salt in a clearing

location.placeName: Forest clearing off a sand road

sighting.description: Witness found a circle of about 30 candles with a line of salt across a clearing, and several people standing outside it in silence. The witness left and reported it. The candles were still burning at first light.

evidence.caption: Circle of candles and a line of salt, dusk

triage.summary: A gathering with a bonfire permit and candles supplied by the venue.
triage.memo: A private gathering had a valid fire permit for the same date and clearing. The candles were supplied in bulk by the organiser, and the salt is consistent with a food-and-drink table. No claim of ritual was made by anyone present. The Bureau records the arrangement and makes no comment on anyone’s beliefs. Recommended: Director’s review.

title: Ledger of a society that does not exist

sighting.description: Witness, a records clerk, found a bound ledger annotated with membership entries under the heading "Ninth Meridian". Entries run from 1932 to the present and appear in a consistent hand. The clerk photographed three pages and returned the ledger to its shelf. It was not on the shelf the following day. The Ninth Meridian Society is a fictional society in the Bureau’s files.

evidence.quote: The handwriting never changes. Ninety years, one hand.
evidence.speaker: Records clerk

evidence.caption: Three pages of the ledger, photographed at the shelf

triage.summary: Documentary evidence of a long-running membership record; the ledger has since been removed.
triage.memo: The photographs show a consistent hand across nine decades, which is unusual for any record and remarkable for a membership ledger. The ledger’s disappearance is noted and is not, in itself, evidence of anything. The Bureau’s file on the Ninth Meridian Society is fictional and no claim is made about any real group. Recommended for investigation.
